paragraphs.source_en: Whenever a great human calamity occurs, some grotesque clown always seems to occupy a position of power. How could the fate of Osaka Castle have been entrusted to such a creature? Lord Ieyasu and all those around him were at least determined to secure a lasting peace, while Osaka Castle was filled with such a rabble!

units.source_en: Whenever a great human calamity occurs, some grotesque clown always seems to occupy a position of power.
units.source_zh: 人间发生莫大的不幸时，总有一些奇怪的小丑身居高位。

units.source_en: How could the fate of Osaka Castle have been entrusted to such a creature?
units.source_zh: 怎会把大坂城的命运托付于这样一个东西？

units.source_en: Lord Ieyasu and all those around him were at least determined to secure a lasting peace, while Osaka Castle was filled with such a rabble!

ja.t: しようとしている。それなのに
にいるのは、このような

units.source_zh: 至少，在家康公及其周围人心中，都欲坚决巩固太平，大坂城中却是这样一群乌合之众！

paragraphs.source_zh: 人间发生莫大的不幸时，总有一些奇怪的小丑身居高位。怎会把大坂城的命运托付于这样一个东西？至少，在家康公及其周围人心中，都欲坚决巩固太平，大坂城中却是这样一群乌合之众！

paragraphs.source_en: Katsushige had assumed that Harunaga had already formed a definite plan and had come specially today because, if the work were postponed until a certain time, he could persuade the rōnin to disperse of their own accord. But one question revealed that the man's mind was nothing but a mire, and still he tried to brazen it out with specious arguments!

units.source_en: Katsushige had assumed that Harunaga had already formed a definite plan and had come specially today because, if the work were postponed until a certain time, he could persuade the rōnin to disperse of their own accord.
units.source_zh: 胜重本以为，治长早已有了主见，若能延期到某时，他便能说服浪人自行散去，今日才特意来访。

units.source_en: But one question revealed that the man's mind was nothing but a mire, and still he tried to brazen it out with specious arguments!

ja.t: いただしてみれば、この
しかなく、それでもなお

units.source_zh: 一问方知，此人心中一团烂泥，竟还强词夺理！

paragraphs.source_zh: 胜重本以为，治长早已有了主见，若能延期到某时，他便能说服浪人自行散去，今日才特意来访。一问方知，此人心中一团烂泥，竟还强词夺理！

paragraphs.source_en: Ōno Harunaga stood rooted to the spot. Biting his lip, he stared blankly at Katsushige. But could Katsushige's sincerity truly bring him to his senses?

units.source_en: Ōno Harunaga stood rooted to the spot.
units.source_zh: 大野治长愣在当地。

units.source_en: Biting his lip, he stared blankly at Katsushige.
units.source_zh: 他咬着嘴唇，茫然盯着胜重。

units.source_en: But could Katsushige's sincerity truly bring him to his senses?

ja.t: まさせることができるのだろうか。

units.source_zh: 可是，胜重的诚意真能让他清醒吗？

paragraphs.source_zh: 大野治长愣在当地。他咬着嘴唇，茫然盯着胜重。可是，胜重的诚意真能让他清醒吗？
